name: Idea-ology Ephemera Pack, Snippets
descriptionOriginal: A pack of die-cut paper ephemera in a vintage style: labels, typography, tickets and frames, made for layering.
whyWeLikeIt: Ready-made aged paper bits give a page a travelled, collected look on day one. Tim Holtz's range is built for collage, and Ranger describes this pack as sized for journals, cards, tags and albums.
limitations: The look is aged and vintage, not soft or modern. The piece count and contents differ between editions and retailers (111 on the listing Cowork read, 136 on Ranger's page), so the exact pieces may vary. These are printed pieces, not found paper, so they work best alongside your own scraps.
qualityNote: Customers say it is good quality and versatile for paper projects. Concern: the look is aged and vintage, not a soft floral.
